title: Quadridecimal
summary: QUADRIDEC'IMAL, adjective [Latin quadra and decem.] In crystallography, designating a crystal whose prism or the middle part has four faces and two summits, containing together ten faces.

inlines.v: QUADRIDEC'IMAL, adjective [Latin quadra and decem.] In crystallography, designating a crystal whose prism or the middle part has four faces and two summits, containing together ten faces.
